regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: FOLFOXIRI combines three chemotherapy medicines with folinic acid to treat colorectal cancer that has spread. The aim is cancer control, symptom relief and, for selected people, a response that allows further local treatment after specialist review.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Irinotecan: The body converts irinotecan into SN-38. This traps an enzyme called topoisomerase I while DNA is being copied, causing damage that can stop cancer cells dividing. Normal bowel and blood-forming cells can also be affected. Oxaliplatin: Oxaliplatin makes links within DNA. These interfere with copying and repair, which can stop a cancer cell dividing. Healthy tissues can also be affected. Folinic acid: Folinic acid helps fluorouracil remain bound to an enzyme needed to make DNA. In this regimen it increases fluorouracil activity and can also increase its unwanted effects. It is not a vitamin supplement to start yourself. Fluorouracil: Fluorouracil interferes with the production and use of DNA and RNA, the instructions cells need to grow. The infusion extends exposure over approximately two days.

regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Oxaliplatin: Oxaliplatin makes links within DNA. These interfere with copying and repair, which can stop a cancer cell dividing. Phase 2 is capecitabine 800 mg/m² twice daily on Days 1–5 of each seven-day cycle for five weeks with radiotherapy. regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Aflibercept with FOLFIRI is used for metastatic colorectal cancer that is resistant to, or has progressed after, an oxaliplatin-containing treatment. The aim is to control the cancer and symptoms; treatment continues while its benefit outweighs its side effects.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Aflibercept: Aflibercept acts as a decoy receptor. It binds VEGF-A, VEGF-B and placental growth factor (PlGF), reducing signals that help new blood vessels support a tumour. Normal blood vessels and wound healing can also be affected. Irinotecan: The body converts irinotecan into SN-38. This traps an enzyme called topoisomerase I while DNA is being copied, causing damage that can stop cancer cells dividing. Normal bowel and blood-forming cells can also be affected. Folinic acid: Folinic acid helps fluorouracil remain bound to an enzyme needed to make DNA. In this regimen it increases fluorouracil activity and can also increase its unwanted effects. It is not a vitamin supplement to start yourself. Fluorouracil: Fluorouracil interferes with the production and use of DNA and RNA, the instructions cells need to grow. The infusion extends exposure over approximately two days.

regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: FOLFOX-4 may be given after surgery for stage II or III colon cancer, or for colorectal cancer that has spread. Your team explains the aim, alternatives and how benefit will be reviewed.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Oxaliplatin makes links within DNA. These interfere with copying and repair, which can stop a cancer cell dividing. Healthy tissues can also be affected. Folinic acid helps fluorouracil remain bound to an enzyme needed to make DNA. In this regimen it increases fluorouracil activity and can also increase its unwanted effects. It is not a vitamin supplement to start yourself. Fluorouracil interferes with the production and use of DNA and RNA, the instructions cells need to grow. The infusion extends exposure over approximately two days.

regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Panitumumab: Panitumumab attaches to EGFR, a receptor on the outside of cells. This can interrupt signals that help some bowel cancers grow. A tumour RAS test helps identify whether this approach is suitable. EGFR also supports healthy skin, which explains why skin and nail changes need attention. Irinotecan: The body converts irinotecan into SN-38. This traps an enzyme called topoisomerase I while DNA is being copied, causing damage that can stop cancer cells dividing. Normal bowel and blood-forming cells can also be affected. Folinic acid: Folinic acid helps fluorouracil remain bound to an enzyme needed to make DNA. In this regimen it increases fluorouracil activity and can also increase its unwanted effects. It is not a vitamin supplement to start yourself. Fluorouracil: Fluorouracil interferes with the production and use of DNA and RNA, the instructions cells need to grow. The infusion extends exposure over approximately two days.
